import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.gridspec import GridSpec
import base64
from io import BytesIO
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('/app/benchmark/data.csv')
df.columns = df.columns.str.strip()

# Derived columns
df['over_int'] = df['over'].apply(lambda x: int(str(x).split('.')[0]))

def phase(over_int):
    if over_int <= 5:  return 'Powerplay (1-6)'
    elif over_int <= 15: return 'Middle Overs (7-15)'
    else: return 'Death Overs (16-20)'

df['phase'] = df['over_int'].apply(phase)
df['is_dot'] = ((df['runs_of_bat'] == 0) & (df['extras'] == 0)).astype(int)
df['is_boundary'] = df['runs_of_bat'].isin([4, 6]).astype(int)
df['is_wicket'] = (df['wicket_type'] != '').astype(int)

# KPI calculations
total_runs = df['runs_of_bat'].sum() + df['extras'].sum()
total_balls = len(df)
total_overs = total_balls / 6
kpi_rpo = round(total_runs / total_overs, 2) if total_overs > 0 else 0

total_deliveries = len(df)
boundary_balls = df['is_boundary'].sum()
kpi_boundary_pct = round(boundary_balls / total_deliveries * 100, 1)

dot_balls = df['is_dot'].sum()
kpi_dot_pct = round(dot_balls / total_deliveries * 100, 1)

n_matches = df['match_no'].nunique()
total_extras = df['extras'].sum()
kpi_extras_per_match = round(total_extras / n_matches, 1)

total_wickets = df['is_wicket'].sum()
kpi_wickets_per_match = round(total_wickets / n_matches, 2)

# Chart helpers
TEAM_COLORS = {
    'SRH': '#FF8C00', 'RCB': '#DC143C', 'CSK': '#FFD700', 'MI': '#004B8D',
    'DC': '#1F75FE', 'KKR': '#4B0082', 'PBKS': '#ED1D24', 'RR': '#FF1493',
    'GT': '#008080', 'LSG': '#00BFFF'
}
PHASE_COLORS = {'Powerplay (1-6)': '#2E86AB', 'Middle Overs (7-15)': '#A23B72', 'Death Overs (16-20)': '#F18F01'}

def fig_to_b64(fig):
    buf = BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format='png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=120)
    plt.close(fig)
    buf.seek(0)
    return base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()

def bar_chart(data_dict, title, xlabel, ylabel, color='#2E86AB', figsize=(8, 4.5), horizontal=False, label_fmt=None):
    labels = list(data_dict.keys())
    values = list(data_dict.values())
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    if horizontal:
        bars = ax.barh(labels, values, color=color)
        ax.set_xlabel(ylabel)
        ax.set_ylabel(xlabel)
    else:
        bars = ax.bar(labels, values, color=color)
        ax.set_xlabel(xlabel)
        ax.set_ylabel(ylabel)
        ax.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
    for bar in bars:
        h = bar.get_height()
        label = f'{h:.1f}' if label_fmt == 'float1' else (f'{h:.2f}' if label_fmt == 'float2' else str(int(h)))
        ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, h + 0.01*max(values, default=1), label, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    fig.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def heatmap(data_2d, x_labels, y_labels, title, cmap='YlOrRd', figsize=(9, 6)):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    im = ax.imshow(data_2d, cmap=cmap, aspect='auto')
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(x_labels)))
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(y_labels)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(x_labels, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
    ax.set_yticklabels(y_labels, fontsize=8)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
    plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, shrink=0.8)
    for i in range(len(y_labels)):
        for j in range(len(x_labels)):
            text = ax.text(j, i, f'{data_2d[i, j]:.1f}', ha='center', va='center', color='black', fontsize=7)
    fig.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

# Pre-compute all data
n_matches = df['match_no'].nunique()
n_venues = df['venue'].nunique()
n_teams = df['batting_team'].nunique()
total_deliveries = len(df)
total_overs_count = total_deliveries / 6
total_runs_scored = int(df['runs_of_bat'].sum())
total_wickets = int(df['is_wicket'].sum())
total_extras_all = int(df['extras'].sum())

# Striker stats
striker_runs = df.groupby('striker')['runs_of_bat'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
striker_balls = df.groupby('striker').size()
striker_sr = ((striker_runs / striker_balls) * 100).round(1)
striker_4s = df[df['runs_of_bat']==4].groupby('striker').size()
striker_6s = df[df['runs_of_bat']==6].groupby('striker').size()

# Phase-wise batting
phase_runs = df.groupby('phase')['runs_of_bat'].sum()
phase_balls = df.groupby('phase').size()
phase_rpo = (phase_runs / (phase_balls/6)).round(2)
phase_boundaries = df.groupby('phase')['is_boundary'].sum()
phase_bpct = (phase_boundaries / phase_balls * 100).round(1)
phase_dots = df.groupby('phase')['is_dot'].sum()
phase_dot_pct = (phase_dots / phase_balls * 100).round(1)

# Bowler stats
bowler_balls = df.groupby('bowler').size()
bowler_runs = df.groupby('bowler')['runs_of_bat'].sum()
bowler_wickets = df[df['is_wicket']==1].groupby('bowler').size()
bowler_economy = (bowler_runs / (bowler_balls/6)).round(2)
bowler_dot_pct = (df.groupby('bowler')['is_dot'].sum() / bowler_balls * 100).round(1)

# Team stats
team_runs = df.groupby('batting_team')['runs_of_bat'].sum()
team_balls = df.groupby('batting_team').size()
team_sr = ((team_runs / team_balls) * 100).round(1)
team_rpo = (team_runs / (team_balls/6)).round(2)
team_boundaries = df.groupby('batting_team')['is_boundary'].sum()
team_dots = df.groupby('batting_team')['is_dot'].sum()
team_bpct = (team_boundaries / team_balls * 100).round(1)
team_dot_pct = (team_dots / team_balls * 100).round(1)
team_extras = df.groupby('batting_team')['extras'].sum()

# Team bowling (opposition)
opp_runs = df.groupby('bowling_team')['runs_of_bat'].sum()
opp_balls = df.groupby('bowling_team').size()
opp_wickets = df.groupby('bowling_team')['is_wicket'].sum()
opp_extras = df.groupby('bowling_team')['extras'].sum()
opp_economy = (opp_runs / (opp_balls/6)).round(2)
opp_dot_pct = (df.groupby('bowling_team')['is_dot'].sum() / opp_balls * 100).round(1)

# Extras breakdown
wide_runs = df.groupby('bowling_team')['wide'].sum()
noball_runs = df.groupby('bowling_team')['noballs'].sum()
bye_runs = df.groupby('bowling_team')['byes'].sum()
legbye_runs = df.groupby('bowling_team')['legbyes'].sum()

# Venue stats
venue_runs = df.groupby('venue')['runs_of_bat'].sum()
venue_balls = df.groupby('venue').size()
venue_rpo = (venue_runs / (venue_balls/6)).round(2)
venue_boundaries = df.groupby('venue')['is_boundary'].sum()
venue_bpct = (venue_boundaries / venue_balls * 100).round(1)
venue_dots = df.groupby('venue')['is_dot'].sum()
venue_dot_pct = (venue_dots / venue_balls * 100).round(1)
venue_wickets = df.groupby('venue')['is_wicket'].sum()
venue_matches = df.groupby('venue')['match_no'].nunique()

# Innings comparison
innings1_runs = df[df['innings']==1].groupby('match_no')['runs_of_bat'].sum()
innings2_runs = df[df['innings']==2].groupby('match_no')['runs_of_bat'].sum()
innings1_matches = set(df[df['innings']==1]['match_no'].unique())
innings2_matches = set(df[df['innings']==2]['match_no'].unique())
common_matches = innings1_matches & innings2_matches
avg_innings1 = round(innings1_runs[innings1_runs.index.isin(common_matches)].mean(), 1)
avg_innings2 = round(innings2_runs[innings2_runs.index.isin(common_matches)].mean(), 1)

# Dismissal types
dismissal_types = df[df['is_wicket']==1]['wicket_type'].value_counts()

# Phase-wise top bowlers
phase_top = {}
for p in ['Powerplay (1-6)', 'Middle Overs (7-15)', 'Death Overs (16-20)']:
    p_wickets = df[(df['phase']==p) & (df['is_wicket']==1)].groupby('bowler').size().sort_values(ascending=False).head(5)
    p_econ = df[df['phase']==p].groupby('bowler')['runs_of_bat'].sum()
    p_balls_ph = df[df['phase']==p].groupby('bowler').size()
    p_econ_ph = (p_econ / (p_balls_ph/6)).round(2)
    phase_top[p] = {k: {'wickets': int(p_wickets.get(k, 0)), 'economy': p_econ_ph.get(k, 0)} for k in p_wickets.index}

# Extras by team dataframe
extras_df = pd.DataFrame({'Wides': wide_runs, 'No-Balls': noball_runs, 'Byes': bye_runs, 'Leg-Byes': legbye_runs}).fillna(0)
extras_df['Total'] = extras_df.sum(axis=1)
extras_df_sorted = extras_df.sort_values('Total', ascending=False)

# Generate all charts
phase_labels = ['Powerplay (1-6)', 'Middle Overs (7-15)', 'Death Overs (16-20)']

top15 = striker_runs.head(15)
top15_sr = {k: striker_sr.get(k, 0) for k in top15.index}
top15_4s = {k: int(striker_4s.get(k, 0)) for k in top15.index}
top15_6s = {k: int(striker_6s.get(k, 0)) for k in top15.index}

chart_top_scorers = bar_chart(top15.to_dict(), 'Top Run Scorers - IPL 2026', 'Batsman', 'Runs', color='#2E86AB', figsize=(10, 5.5), horizontal=True)
chart_top_scorers_sr = bar_chart(top15_sr, 'Strike Rate - Top Run Scorers', 'Batsman', 'Strike Rate', color='#F18F01', figsize=(10, 5.5), horizontal=True, label_fmt='float1')
chart_boundary_4s = bar_chart(top15_4s, 'Fours Hit - Top Run Scorers', 'Batsman', '4s', color='#1F75FE', figsize=(10, 5.5), horizontal=True)
chart_boundary_6s = bar_chart(top15_6s, 'Sixes Hit - Top Run Scorers', 'Batsman', '6s', color='#DC143C', figsize=(10, 5.5), horizontal=True)

top15_wickets = bowler_wickets.sort_values(ascending=False).head(15)
chart_top_wickets = bar_chart(top15_wickets.to_dict(), 'Top Wicket Takers - IPL 2026', 'Bowler', 'Wickets', color='#2E86AB', figsize=(10, 5.5), horizontal=True)
top15_economy = {k: bowler_economy.get(k, 0) for k in top15_wickets.index}
chart_wicket_economy = bar_chart(top15_economy, 'Economy Rate - Top Wicket Takers', 'Bowler', 'Economy', color='#F18F01', figsize=(10, 5.5), horizontal=True, label_fmt='float2')
top15_dot = {k: bowler_dot_pct.get(k, 0) for k in top15_wickets.index}
chart_wicket_dot = bar_chart(top15_dot, 'Dot Ball % - Top Wicket Takers', 'Bowler', 'Dot Ball %', color='#A23B72', figsize=(10, 5.5), horizontal=True, label_fmt='float1')

chart_phase_rpo = bar_chart({p: phase_rpo.get(p, 0) for p in phase_labels}, 'Runs Per Over by Phase', 'Match Phase', 'RPO', color=list(PHASE_COLORS.values()), figsize=(8, 4.5))
chart_phase_bpct = bar_chart({p: phase_bpct.get(p, 0) for p in phase_labels}, 'Boundary % by Phase', 'Match Phase', 'Boundary %', color=list(PHASE_COLORS.values()), figsize=(8, 4.5))
chart_phase_dot = bar_chart({p: phase_dot_pct.get(p, 0) for p in phase_labels}, 'Dot Ball % by Phase', 'Match Phase', 'Dot Ball %', color=list(PHASE_COLORS.values()), figsize=(8, 4.5))

team_rpo_sorted = dict(sorted(team_rpo.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True))
team_colors_list = [TEAM_COLORS.get(t, '#888888') for t in team_rpo_sorted.keys()]
chart_team_rpo = bar_chart(team_rpo_sorted, 'Team Batting - Runs Per Over', 'Team', 'RPO', color=team_colors_list, figsize=(9, 4.5))
team_bpct_sorted = dict(sorted(team_bpct.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True))
chart_team_bpct = bar_chart(team_bpct_sorted, 'Team Batting - Boundary %', 'Team', 'Boundary %', color=[TEAM_COLORS.get(t, '#888888') for t in team_bpct_sorted.keys()], figsize=(9, 4.5))
team_dot_sorted = dict(sorted(team_dot_pct.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True))
chart_team_dot = bar_chart(team_dot_sorted, 'Team Batting - Dot Ball %', 'Team', 'Dot Ball %', color=[TEAM_COLORS.get(t, '#888888') for t in team_dot_sorted.keys()], figsize=(9, 4.5))
team_economy_sorted = dict(sorted(opp_economy.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True))
chart_team_economy = bar_chart(team_economy_sorted, 'Team Bowling - Economy Rate', 'Team', 'Economy', color=[TEAM_COLORS.get(t, '#888888') for t in team_economy_sorted.keys()], figsize=(9, 4.5))
team_extras_sorted = dict(sorted(team_extras.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True))
chart_team_extras = bar_chart(team_extras_sorted, 'Extras Conceded by Team', 'Team', 'Total Extras', color=[TEAM_COLORS.get(t, '#888888') for t in team_extras_sorted.keys()], figsize=(9, 4.5))

venue_rpo_sorted = dict(sorted(venue_rpo.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True))
chart_venue_rpo = bar_chart(venue_rpo_sorted, 'Runs Per Over by Venue', 'Venue', 'RPO', color='#2E86AB', figsize=(10, 5))
venue_bpct_sorted = dict(sorted(venue_bpct.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True))
chart_venue_bpct = bar_chart(venue_bpct_sorted, 'Boundary % by Venue', 'Venue', 'Boundary %', color='#F18F01', figsize=(10, 5))
venue_dot_sorted = dict(sorted(venue_dot_pct.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True))
chart_venue_dot = bar_chart(venue_dot_sorted, 'Dot Ball % by Venue', 'Venue', 'Dot Ball %', color='#A23B72', figsize=(10, 5))

# Extras pie
extra_types = {'Wides': int(wide_runs.sum()), 'No-Balls': int(noball_runs.sum()), 'Byes': int(bye_runs.sum()), 'Leg-Byes': int(legbye_runs.sum())}
fig_extras_pie, ax_ep = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 5))
ax_ep.pie(extra_types.values(), labels=extra_types.keys(), autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=['#2E86AB','#F18F01','#A23B72','#FFD700'], startangle=90)
ax_ep.set_title('Extras Breakdown - All Teams', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
fig_extras_pie.tight_layout()
chart_extras_pie = fig_to_b64(fig_extras_pie)
